pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth edge transitions. Patches on the upper flank and shoulder are larger and more densely pigmented than those on the lower hindquarters and ventral region, which show increased pixel-level fading.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming clear tri-point and quadri-point junctions. Pathway thickness is relatively constant across the mid-flank, widening slightly towards the ventral and inguinal areas.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the neck mane, characterized by dense, short bristly hair tufts creating a jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple symbiotic birds (Oxpeckers) perched on the upper dorsal ridge and the lower mid-flank region.
